request.prompt:
Describe actual visible changes in chronological RGB frames. Bind entities across time. Record at most three persistent changes or reversals and a neutral initial scene context. Robot-only motion, camera movement and occlusion are not automatically environment changes. Do not infer purpose, utility, completion or a task plan. Return only JSON. JSON layer check: coverage occurs exactly once at the top level, alongside context and changes. Never place coverage inside a changes item. Output shape (empty structure, not scene evidence): {"context":"brief scene","changes":[{"b":"earlier supplied ID","a":"later supplied ID","object":"brief object","before":"brief state","after":"brief state"}],"coverage":"complete"}. Exact keys context, changes, coverage. context is one neutral first-scene sentence max 240 characters. changes at most 3 items; exact keys b, a, object, before, after. b and a are supplied evidence IDs, time(b)<time(a). object/before/after each max 160 characters; brief visible descriptions. coverage=complete|overflow|occluded|no_observable_change. Host assigns change numbers and looks up timestamps; do not generate entity IDs or timestamps.
EVIDENCE_TIME_MS: {"c0a":3000,"c0b":2000,"c1a":6000,"c1b":5000,"f0000":0,"f0002":2000,"f0003":3000,"f0005":5000,"f0008":8000,"f0011":11000,"f0012":12000,"f0014":14000}

Use only supplied evidence at its exact time. Goal completion, direct readiness, partial preparation, event impact and reversal are separate. Direct readiness means the object can be placed under the common capabilities without further changing other environment structures. A useful change may be insufficient preparation. Lack of proof of benefit is not evidence of harm. Reversal needs an earlier observed gain then loss of the same relation; net_effect compares current with initial state. When completed, readiness and partial preparation are not_applicable. Completion and mixed are allowed together if a separate harmful change has evidence. Unknown is allowed; do not invent hidden physics, unobserved changes, or a task tree. Return one complete JSON, no prose or markdown.
GOAL: Put the blue cube completely inside the transparent box so it rests on the box floor. Release it and leave it still.
CAPABILITIES: One tabletop arm can approach, grasp, carry, release, and interact with visible movable structures. It cannot pass through rigid solids, teleport or resize objects. Hidden locks, load capacity and exact reach remain unknown.
CHANGES (indices assigned by host): {"changes":[],"context":"scripted neutral context","coverage":"no_observable_change"}
EVIDENCE_TIME_MS: {"c0a":3000,"c0b":2000,"c1a":6000,"c1b":5000,"f0000":0,"f0002":2000,"f0003":3000,"f0005":5000,"f0008":8000,"f0011":11000,"f0012":12000,"f0014":14000}
Directly predict goal state and change impacts from supplied observations. Then give a few neutral visual checks of that direct judgment.
FINAL_CONTRACT: Exact keys: state, impacts, net_effect, reversal, reason. state exact keys goal_done, direct_ready, partial_preparation; values "true"|"false"|"unknown" (last two also "not_applicable"). impacts at most 3 items with exact keys change (integer index in CHANGES), effect (beneficial|harmful|irrelevant|mixed|unknown). net_effect=beneficial|harmful|unchanged|mixed|unknown; reversal="true"|"false"|"unknown". reason one sentence max 240 characters. Cite no invented changes.
DRAFT_CONTRACT: Exact top keys judgment, tests. judgment follows FINAL_CONTRACT. tests at most 4 items; exact keys change (integer CHANGES index, or -1 for current goal), ref (one evidence ID), predicate (a single positive yes/no visible assertion max 160 characters at that exact ref). The host numbers tests. No usefulness words, no hypothetical story in predicate. Avoid negated predicates.
